description.zh:
大区ID，不填默认所有大区。取值：

- huadong

- xinan

- huanan

- huabei

- huazhong
description.en:
The district ID. If not specified, all districts are included. Valid values:

- huadong

- xinan

- huanan

- huabei

- huazhong

description.zh: 待查询的云渲染实例 ID 列表，不填默认所有实例 ID。
description.en: The list of GCS instance IDs to query. If not specified, all instance IDs are included.

description.zh: GCS 实例的规格，不填默认所有实例规格。
description.en: The instance type of GCS. If not specified, all instance types are included.

description.zh: 最大结果数。取值范围 1~200，默认值 200。
description.en: The maximum number of results. Valid values: 1 to 200. Default: 200.

description.zh: 上一次查询返回的 Token，首次查询可为空。
description.en: The token returned from the previous query. Leave empty for the first query.

description.zh: 项目ID，不填默认查询所有项目下的实例。
description.en: The project ID. If not specified, instances from all projects are queried.

description.zh:
云渲染实例话状态，包括：
- CREATING：创建中
- RUNNING：实例运行中
- OPERATING：实例运维中
- DELETING: 实例删除中
- MIGRATING: 实例迁移中
description.en:
The status of GCS instances. Valid values:

- CREATING: Creating

- RUNNING: during instance runtime

- OPERATING: O\&M

- DELETING: Deleting

- MIGRATING: instance migration

title.en: Query the list of cloud rendering instances
